messages:
rafael-partnerships: Uploading Nebula joint solution brief assets to the partnership drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/NebulaAssets-2026
rafael-partnerships: Need quick review: logo lockups, one-pager copy, marketplace thumbnail (1200x628), and partner quote metadata. Target publish to cloud marketplace next Wed.

anya-design: pulling files. first glance  the Nebula mark has a minimum-clearance of 10px in their PDF. Current lockup uses 6px. Will update.

nikita-nebula: Thanks for the heads up. Confirm Nebula brand guide v2: full-color preferred on white; single-color on dark; no gradients. Also we require the trademark symbol on first usage of their product name NebulaEdge.

anya-design: noted on TM. I'll add 4 (trade mark) to first use and bump clearspace to 10px. Also question on which font to use for the co-headline; Nebula recommends Inter, but we use Founders Grotesk. Any concerns?

trent-marketing: Inter is fine for partner lockups only if we include fallback in the exported PNGs. For the web listing let's rasterize text to avoid font mismatch.

mina-legal: Legal quick note: make sure Nebula's quote has signatory + exact title. Also can't include proprietary performance numbers in the public marketplace tile. If the brief references throughput, use phrasing like 'significantly reduced inference latency' not exact ms.

rafael-partnerships: @nikita-nebula can you confirm who signs the quote and provide a short title string we can embed in metadata?

nikita-nebula: Will get Carla Ruiz, Head of Solutions, to sign. She can approve by EOD tomorrow. Quote draft: "NebulaEdge + Redwood reduces inference cost and brings predictable latency to edge deployments." OK to adjust wording for compliance.

mina-legal: Suggest edit: "NebulaEdge with Redwood lowers inference cost while maintaining predictable latency for edge deployments." Slightly quieter, less marketing-specific.

nikita-nebula: Carla is happy with the edited version. She also requested that the Nebula logo not be placed on top of any pattern texture.

anya-design: good call. For the marketplace thumbnail I'm proposing: left side lockup, right side short bullet: "Edge AI. On-prem + cloud." Background should be a subtle gradient? Nebula forbids gradients on logo area. I'll confine gradient to the right panel only.

trent-marketing: Also need an OG image (1200x630) and a small square (400x400) for the partner directory. Can we get exports in PNG/SVG and a JPG fallback for the marketplace?

anya-design: yes. I'll export PNG (1200x628), JPG (600x314), SVG for lockup, and 400x400 PNG. I'll include descriptive alt text for each asset.

ci-bot: asset-scan: detected missing alt-text on /thumbnail/nebula_tile_1200x628.png and low contrast for button text on 600x314.jpg.

anya-design: fixing alt text and bumping button color contrast; using #0b3a66 for CTA which meets 4.5:1 with white.

mina-legal: quick TM check: ensure NebulaEdge4 appears in the first paragraph and that partner legal gets a copy of final one-pager before publish. Also add the following to metadata: partner_consent=true, asset_license=co-marketing-2026-v1.

rafael-partnerships: will add metadata fields. Trent, can you stage the marketplace listing in the vendor portal once assets are final so Nebula can preview?

trent-marketing: yes I have vendor portal access. Plan: stage draft by Thu, request Nebula preview, finalize Friday.

nikita-nebula: we'll validate on our side and return any micro-requests. Also reminder: Nebula requires a short technical appendix PDF (2 pages) describing supported platforms and validated GPU configurations. We've uploaded that as /tech/nebula-appendix_v1.pdf

anya-design: thanks, I'll include a 2-up callout on the one-pager referencing the appendix.

ci-bot: asset-scan: re-run complete. All images now have alt-text. Color contrast passes. No forbidden fonts detected. Metadata fields missing: partner_consent, asset_license.

rafael-partnerships: added metadata partner_consent=true, asset_license=co-marketing-2026-v1 to the Drive folder manifest.

mina-legal: final check: remove the phrase "best-in-class" from any public-facing text. Replace with 'widely adopted'.

trent-marketing: updated copy in one-pager and marketplace description. Pushed draft to vendor portal (staging). Link: https://marketplace.staging.example.com/listings/nebula-redwood-dedicated-draft

nikita-nebula: Preview looks good. Carla will sign the quote tomorrow morning. Thank you!

rafael-partnerships: action items recap: 1) Anya  update lockups (10px), add TM, export all sizes + rasterize headline for web tiles. 2) Mina  legal to approve final one-pager and confirm 'widely adopted' phrasing. 3) Trent  stage listing and send preview link. 4) Nikita  confirm Carla sign-off. 5) CI-bot  re-scan after final exports. Target publish after partner sign-off.

anya-design: on it, uploading new exports in ~40 mins.

ci-bot: reminder: please include accessible alt-text that describes function, not just visual elements. Example: 'Thumbnail showing Nebula and Redwood logos with callout: "Edge AI. On-prem + cloud."'

rafael-partnerships: thanks everyone. looping back after Carla signs. :rocket:
